[[File:JonvanRood1.jpg|thumb|Jon van Rood (Robert Koch Prize, Dec. 1977]]
'''Johannes Joseph "Jon" van Rood''' (7 April 1926, [[Scheveningen]] – 21 July 2017) was a Dutch [[immunologist]]. He founded [[Eurotransplant]] in 1967,<ref name="history">[http://www.eurotransplant.org/cms/index.php?page=history History] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190830121818/https://www.eurotransplant.org/cms/index.php?page=history |date=2019-08-30 }}, Eurotransplant. Retrieved on 29 Juli 2017.</ref> a non-profit organization responsible for encouraging and coordinating organ transplants.

==Awards==
In 1977 van Rood was awarded the [[Robert Koch Prize]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.robert-koch-stiftung.de/index.php?article_id=15&clang=0|title=Robert Koch Stiftung - Robert-Koch-Preis|website=Robert-koch-stiftung.de|access-date=10 November 2017|archive-date=6 October 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071006134019/http://www.robert-koch-stiftung.de/ptraeger.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 1978, he was awarded the [[Wolf Prize in Medicine]], jointly with [[George D. Snell]] and [[Jean Dausset]], "for his contribution to the understanding of the complexity of the [[Human leukocyte antigen|HLA]] system in man and its implications in transplantation and in disease."<ref>[http://www.wolffund.org.il/cat.asp?id=24&cat_title=MEDICINE The Wolf Prize in Medicine] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090226015735/http://www.wolffund.org.il/cat.asp?id=24&cat_title=MEDICINE |date=2009-02-26 }}</ref> Van Rood was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1978.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4713 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304055210/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4713 |title=Jon van Rood |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |archive-date=4 March 2016}}</ref> In 1989 he was awarded the [[Ernst Jung Prize|Ernst Jung Prize for Medicine]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://jung-stiftung.de/en/the-awards/ernst-jung-prize-for-medicine/laureates-1976-to-2018/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200331090401/https://jung-stiftung.de/en/the-awards/ernst-jung-prize-for-medicine/laureates-1976-to-2018/ |title=Laureates 1976 to 2018 |publisher=Ernst Jung Foundation |archive-date=31 March 2020}}</ref>

==Death==
He died on 21 July 2017 in Leeuwarden.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.telegraaf.nl/binnenland/28791512/__Oprichter_Eurotransplant_overleden__.html|title=Oprichter Eurotransplant overleden|publisher=Telegraaf.nl|date=29 July 2017|access-date=29 July 2017|language=nl|trans-title=Founder Eurotransplant died|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170731153815/http://www.telegraaf.nl/binnenland/28791512/__Oprichter_Eurotransplant_overleden__.html|archive-date=31 July 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>
